tasks.name: 创建笔记数据库模型
实现笔记的后端API
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记搜索功能
优化前端搜索功能

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database schema with fields like title, content, timestamp, and tags; use an ORM like Sequelize or Django ORM.
T1.notes: Ensure proper indexing for fields frequently used in search queries.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations using a backend framework like Express or Django.
T2.notes: Implement input validation and authentication for secure access.

T3.implementation_approach: Create a responsive UI using a framework like React or Vue, with forms for creating and editing notes.
T3.notes: Ensure the UI integrates seamlessly with the backend API.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement a search endpoint in the backend using query parameters to filter notes by keywords or tags.
T4.notes: Consider using full-text search capabilities of the database for better performance.

T5.implementation_approach: Use client-side techniques like debouncing and caching to improve search responsiveness.
T5.notes: Optimize rendering of search results to handle large datasets efficiently.

file_structure.purpose: Define the Note database model with fields for id, title, content, created_at, and updated_at.
Implement CRUD API routes for managing notes, including POST, GET, PUT, and DELETE endpoints.
Initialize the Flask app, register blueprints, and configure the database connection.
Entry point for the Flask application, responsible for running the app.
Provide a user interface for managing notes, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting notes.
Extend the notes API to include a search route (GET /notes/search) for finding notes by title or content.
Enhance the frontend to include a search bar for dynamically filtering notes using the search API.
Provide JavaScript functionality for handling search requests and dynamically updating the notes list.
